text:
zoe: Quick broadcast: shipping SDK v4.2.1 (hotfix) + docs clarification on code snippet licensing and third-party example reuse. Low-risk but please read if you maintain examples or public example repos.

patrick: What's in the hotfix?

zoe: v4.2.1 fixes a regression in streaming where partial spans could duplicate under specific backpressure patterns. Patch is non-breaking; users should upgrade. Changelog: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/changelog#v4.2.1

riley: Docs clarification summary?

zoe: We added a short policy note under "Examples & Snippets" explaining that snippets in our docs are MIT by default unless labeled otherwise, and we added guidance for contributors who want to include third-party snippets (must include a license header and source link). This is to reduce legal friction for downstream users copying examples.

legal-bot: Legal reviewed: OK. Added recommended header text for third-party snippets to the docs contributor guide.

docs: We also tagged all public examples with a license badge and added a one-click copy button that preserves the license header. Migration: automated PRs will add headers where we have clear provenance; ambiguous cases flagged for manual review.

patrick: Ops note: will this change CI or release gating?

release: No CI break. Auto-PRs limited to non-code changes (license header/comments) and will not modify logic. We will run a small repo-scan and open PRs with `[license-add]` tag.

riley: Can we get a short customer-facing blurb?

zoe: "We released SDK v4.2.1 (minor streaming fix) and clarified docs licensing so code examples are clearer to reuse. We will proactively add license headers to ambiguous examples and provide a contributor checklist for third-party snippets."

patrick: Action items:
- docs: add contributor checklist + header template (docs)
- eng: monitor streaming.error.duplicates metric for 48h (patrick)
- release: schedule micro-release announcement and update changelog (release)
- legal: prepare short FAQ entry for community contributors (legal-bot)

docs: Deploy of docs with license badges complete (deploy-2026-03-26-04).

zoe: Thanks all. Upgrade recommended but optional for most users; escalate if someone reports new duplicates after upgrade. :white_check_mark:
